question: Which final-round candidates have not had a call from us in the last 7 days?
sql: SELECT c.name AS candidate_name, cl.name AS client_name, r.title AS role_title, a.stage_updated AS stage_updated, a.next_interview_at AS next_interview, (SELECT MAX(act.at) FROM activities act WHERE act.candidate_id = c.id AND act.with_party = 'candidate' AND act.kind = 'call') AS last_call_date, co.name AS consultant FROM applications a JOIN candidates c ON c.id = a.candidate_id JOIN roles r ON r.id = a.role_id JOIN clients cl ON cl.id = r.client_id LEFT JOIN consultants co ON co.id = c.consultant_id WHERE a.stage = 'final_round' AND a.status = 'active' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM activities x WHERE x.candidate_id = c.id AND x.with_party = 'candidate' AND x.kind = 'call' AND x.at > date('2026-11-25', '-7 day') AND x.at <= '2026-11-25') ORDER BY last_call_date IS NOT NULL, last_call_date ASC LIMIT 200
answer: Two final-round candidates have had no call in the last 7 days: Mei Lin Tan (Fernhallow Capital, Quantitative Researcher, last called 10 November by Hannah Pryce, no interview booked) and Arjun Nair (Lumenfold Research, Research Engineer, last called 18 November by Priya Raman, next interview 27 November at 11:00).

meta.note: Active final_round applications where the candidate has no call (with_party='candidate') dated after 2026-11-18; ordered by longest since last call, never-called first.
